
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
land_use <- vroom(here("data","CBS Land Use.csv"))
rent <- vroom(here("data","CBS Rents.csv"))
```

## Data description

Github link: https://github.com/martin-carricas-asin/Dutch-Rent-Analysis

Data sources:

- Land use data: https://opendata.cbs.nl/portal.html?\_la=en&\_catalog=CBS&tableId=70262ENG&\_theme=1178

- Rent increase data: https://opendata.cbs.nl/portal.html?\_la=en&\_catalog=CBS&tableId=83162ENG&\_theme=1175

```{r}
#| echo: false
 
names(land_use)
 
names(rent)
 

```

The Land Use dataset has `r nrow(land_use)` rows and `r ncol(land_use)` columns. The rent dataset has `r nrow(rent)` rows and `r ncol(rent)` columns

```{r}
#| echo: false

land_useD <- land_use |> mutate(Regions = na_if(Regions, "."),
                                Periods = na_if(Periods, "."),
                                TotalSurface_1 = as.numeric(na_if(TotalSurface_1, ".")),
                                TransportTotal_2 = as.numeric(na_if(TransportTotal_2,".")),
                                Railroad_3 = as.numeric(na_if(Railroad_3,".")),
                                MainRoad_4 = as.numeric(na_if(MainRoad_4,".")),
                                Airport_5 = as.numeric(na_if(Airport_5,".")),
                                BuiltUpAreaTotal_6 = as.numeric(na_if(BuiltUpAreaTotal_6,".")),
                                Residential_7 = as.numeric(na_if(Residential_7,".")),
                                IndustryBusinessPublicInstitutions_8 = as.numeric(na_if(IndustryBusinessPublicInstitutions_8,".")),
                                SocioCulturalFacilities_9 = as.numeric(na_if(SocioCulturalFacilities_9,".")),
                                SemiBuiltUpAreaTotal_10 = as.numeric(na_if(SemiBuiltUpAreaTotal_10,".")),
                                MiningArea_11 = as.numeric(na_if(MiningArea_11,".")),
                                BuildingSite_12 = as.numeric(na_if(BuildingSite_12,".")),
                                OtherSemiBuiltUpArea_13 = as.numeric(na_if(OtherSemiBuiltUpArea_13,".")),
                                RecreationTotal_14 = as.numeric(na_if(RecreationTotal_14, ".")),
                                ParkAndPublicGarden_15 = as.numeric(na_if(ParkAndPublicGarden_15,".")),
                                SportGrounds_16 = as.numeric(na_if(SportGrounds_16, ".")),
                                OtherRecreationUsage_17 = as.numeric(na_if(OtherRecreationUsage_17,".")),
                                AgricultureTotal_18 = as.numeric(na_if(AgricultureTotal_18,".")),
                                Greenhouses_19 = as.numeric(na_if(Greenhouses_19,".")),
                                OtherAgriculturalUsage_20 = as.numeric(na_if(OtherAgriculturalUsage_20,".")),
                                WoodlandAndNatureTotal_21 = as.numeric(na_if(WoodlandAndNatureTotal_21, ".")),
                                Woodland_22 = as.numeric(na_if(Woodland_22,".")),
                                NaturalOpenArea_23 = as.numeric(na_if(NaturalOpenArea_23,".")),
                                WaterTotal_24 = as.numeric(na_if(WaterTotal_24,".")),
                                InlandWaterTotal_25 = as.numeric(na_if(InlandWaterTotal_25,".")),
                                TidalWaterTotal_26 = as.numeric(na_if(TidalWaterTotal_26,".")) )


```

```{r}
#| echo: false
land_useN <- land_useD |> mutate(Periods) |> separate_wider_delim(
  Periods,
  delim = "JJ",
  names = c("Periods","Rest")) |> mutate(Periods = as.numeric(Periods)) |>select(-Rest)


```
